title: Honesty Decay Under Progressive Instruction Fine-Tuning

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Direct practical impact: quantifying honesty decay rates under fine-tuning provides actionable guidance for fine-tuning safety standards. Commercial fine-tuning of safety-aligned models is widespread, and knowing decay thresholds directly informs safe fine-tuning practices.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires progressive fine-tuning with checkpoint saving and honesty benchmark evaluation at each checkpoint. This demands familiarity with fine-tuning pipelines (LoRA/QLoRA), checkpoint management, and running honesty benchmarks. Medium compute helps but the pipeline setup is substantial for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single experiment in principle (fine-tune, checkpoint, evaluate) but many checkpoints and benchmark runs are needed. The fine-tuning + evaluation loop is well-defined but time-intensive. Achievable in 30 hours if limited to one model and one honesty benchmark, but tight.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
